extracted.name: Avocado Cottage Cheese Dip
extracted.description: This cottage cheese dip recipe is a delicious high-protein snack or appetizer! Avocado makes it silky smooth and adds healthy fats. Serve with veggies, crackers, or pita for dipping! Gluten-free.
instruction_lines: In a food processor, place the cottage cheese, avocado, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, and salt. Process until smooth and creamy.
Transfer to a serving bowl and top with everything bagel seasoning and chives.
Serve with crackers and veggies for dipping.
